name: Footer
description: Site footer with brand (logo text or image), nested link columns, contacts, social links, legal links, and copyright. Layouts: 4-column light, compact single row, dark split with a claim + CTAs, or maximal dark with a giant wordmark.
when_to_use: Exactly one Footer per site, placed on the shared layout. Pick split or maximal for brands that want a bold dark closing; compact for minimal sites.
capabilities: logo as text or uploaded image (svg/png/webp)
nested link columns (cols[] with links[] inside)
claim / call-out line with primary + secondary CTA (split variant)
giant wordmark treatment with contact links (maximal variant)
appearance switches show_logo, show_bottom_bar, show_copyright, show_eyebrow (maximal), show_wordmark (maximal), default on
split CTAs link via cta_primary_to / cta_secondary_to

variants.description: Light 4-column layout: brand + tagline left, 3 link columns right. Default.
As columns, narrowed to 3 total: brand + 2 link columns. Extra authored columns are dropped.
As columns, narrowed to 2 total: brand + 1 link column. Extra authored columns are dropped.
Single-row footer: brand, few links, legal.
Dark, claim + cta_primary/cta_secondary left, link columns right.
Dark with a giant wordmark, contacts[] links, and legal row.

breakpoints.mobile: Columns stack vertically; wordmark scales down.
breakpoints.desktop: Multi-column grid; legal row spans the bottom.

ai.prompt_summary: Footer: site footer. Settings: variant (columns|compact|split|maximal), logo_text, logo_image, tagline (columns), claim (split/maximal), address (one line per row), cta_primary + cta_secondary with cta_primary_to / cta_secondary_to (split only), copyright. Switches ('1' default, '0' hides): show_logo, show_bottom_bar (the whole bar: copyright, legal, socials), show_copyright, show_eyebrow + show_wordmark (maximal). Collections: cols[] { title, links[] { label, to } }, contacts[] { label, to } (maximal, e.g. tel:/mailto:), socials[] { label (e.g. IN, LI, YT), to }, legal[] { label, to }. scheme (light|dark): a light variant on the dark band.
ai.content_guidelines: 2-4 link columns with 3-6 links each. Claim one strong sentence. Legal links: Impressum, Datenschutz, AGB. Social labels are short abbreviations, not icon names; the icon comes from the link's host (instagram.com, linkedin.com, xing.com, youtube.com, …) or the label (IN, LI, XI, YT).

field_hints.address: Multiline — one address line per row.
field_hints.contacts: Only rendered by the maximal variant; use tel:/mailto: links.
field_hints.claim: Used by split and maximal variants as the large statement.
